caption: Palazzina di Caccia di Stupinigi, Nichelino
composition: Baroque hunting lodge with central dome topped by a bronze stag and curved wings · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: The camera faces the Palazzina di Caccia di Stupinigi across its vast empty forecourt in the bright light of the 12:03 midday. The baroque hunting lodge spreads symmetrically across the frame, its curved colonnaded wings sweeping left and right to frame the central domed pavilion, where a bronze stag crowns the lantern. The pale stonework and regular rows of windows glow in the high sun beneath a soft blue sky, with parkland trees edging the frame.
alt_text: AI-generated artistic interpretation of Stupinigi under morning light
